title: What happened in AI — Oct 21, 2026
intro: DeepSeek's DeepInfer release dominated the day: an open-source production inference engine reportedly serving 155T tokens a day, released as the U.S. barred DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies.
Agent plumbing kept maturing: WebMCP storefronts at Commerce.com scale, cross-harness memory, and NVIDIA's expanded Agent Toolkit.
highlights: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, its production inference engine.
U.S. bans DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies.
Commerce.com opens ~100,000 domains to agents via WebMCP on Cloudflare.
Ant Group and vLLM release Humming quantized inference kernels.
OpenAI models and Codex arrive in Google Cloud's Model Garden.
Google makes SynthID Detector globally available.
